edits.before: The graph’s existing release order is unchanged.
edits.after: The graph’s existing release order is unchanged: projects release one at a time, and a failing project stops the rest. Concrete TypeScript cleanup is synchronous, so only an asynchronous graph release can keep the backend pending.
edits.depth_source: 26 depth, lifecycle section: 'The inherited graph releases configured projects in order, awaiting returned promises, then the inferred project. This PR connects that completion to the backend; the concrete TypeScript project cleanup itself is synchronous.' Stopping on failure and 'only an asynchronous release can hold it pending' are made explicit here; truth/127 probes execute both.
